newsitem.title: USA: Compact agrees to buy U.S. Cast Polymers.
newsitem.headline: Compact agrees to buy U.S. Cast Polymers.

text.p: Compact Organizational Systems Inc Wednesday said it discontinued its prior business of marketing a day planner and financial organizer due to poor market response and agreed to acquire U.S. Cast Polymers Inc.

The transaction will involve the issuance by the company of a controlling block of its common stock, a recapitalization of the present outstanding common stock of the company, a name change, a complete change in management and other matters, Compact said.
The completion of the transaction is subject to certain conditions and is expected in April.
U.S. Cast Polymers is engaged in the cultured marble business and related businesses and seeks to acquire other companies in the same or related businesses.
